description: Files whose name begins with a dot are treated as hidden and are skipped by default, so a misspelling inside such a file is not reported. When the check-hidden option is enabled, hidden files are checked like any other file. A non-hidden file is always checked. When check-hidden and check-filenames are combined on a hidden file whose name also contains a misspelling, both the misspelled name and the misspelled content are reported. The total count reflects everything that was checked.
